outcomes.name: Percentage of Participants Achieving A Clinical Response
outcomes.definition: Percentage of Participants Achieving A Clinical Response
outcomes.definition_note: EXPLORER-HCM's registered primary is a COMPOSITE RESPONDER endpoint, not an event count and not a continuous measure. Verbatim: a positive clinical response is 'achieved either an improvement of at least 1.5 mL/kg/min in peak oxygen consumption (pVO2) ... AND a reduction of one or more class in New York Heart Association (NYHA) functional classification -OR- an improvement of 3.0 mL/kg/min or more in pVO2 with no worsening in NYHA Functional Class', at 30 weeks. THAT SHAPE MATTERS FOR ANY FUTURE POOLING: it is a two-branch OR of an AND and a threshold, so two trials using different pVO2 thresholds or different NYHA rules are not measuring the same responder, even when both call the endpoint 'clinical response'.

primary.poolable_reason: NOTHING IS POOLED AND NOTHING IS WITHDRAWN. This is an AUDIT-FIRST topic: it has never published an estimate, so there is no claim to defend and none to retract. What this build establishes is identity by registration and the endpoint definition, read from the registry. THE CARD CLAIMED TWO TRIALS AND THIS PAGE CONTAINS ONE. Its index card read 'Audit-first build - 2 trials - AACT-verified'. The only trial on the page is EXPLORER-HCM, NCT03470545. The word 'VALOR' -- the other pivotal mavacamten trial in obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy -- appears ZERO times anywhere in the file. The four other registration numbers present (NCT01035255, NCT01920711, NCT02924727, NCT05901831) are shared-runtime residue that appears on unrelated pages in this corpus and belong to heart-failure trials, not to this topic. THIS IS THE DEFECT CLASS card_alignment_gate CANNOT SEE. An audit-first card is UNCHECKABLE by construction -- it carries no estimate to compare -- so the one surface a reader meets first can overstate the evidence base and no check fires. The previous lane found the same shape corpus-wide in the '2 trials AND k>=3' contradiction on 212 cards; this is the count itself being wrong rather than the criterion beside it.

primary.poolable_verdict_absent_because: NO POOLABILITY VERDICT HAS BEEN MADE FOR THIS TOPIC, and recording False would be a claim this build did not establish. False means 'these cannot legitimately be pooled', which is an assessment; this topic has ONE trial and publishes NO estimate, so the question was never reached. The distinction matters downstream: the orphan-pooled-result check exists to catch a DISPLAYED estimate an engine cannot compute, and with nothing displayed it can only pass vacuously -- which the harness gate correctly refuses to count as evidence. An absent verdict is emitted as an omission instead, which is the honest state and is what that gate is built to distinguish.
